notes.title: Swarm the City: Zombie Evolved Full Release Announcement
notes.content:
Swarm the City: Zombie Evolved Full Release Announcement
After a period of internal development following the release of the EA version, we released the Prologue version as open test in May. After this test, we decided to full release the game on June 17 and will open a discount event in the near future!

Update content.
1. The basic controls are heavily simplified and optimised, you now can command the zombie army smoothly.
2. The zombie generals are revamped, generals are buffed and clearly diversified.
3. The zombie king's magic arsenal is enriched, you now have more ways to deal with humans.
4.  Various lore pieces are placed around the world, and now you can finally discover interesting aspects of zombies and humans.
5. Normal zombies can devour human brains and thus use human weapons and carriers. When you see a decent human weapon, be sure to grab it!
6. Dogs and cows in the city can be zombified so you can use whoofs and moos as rallying cries now.
7. Destroying important buildings and killing important humans drop soul crystals, which provide random Artifacts to buff your armies to destroy human cities more effectively.
8. Killing more people and destroying more cities will allow you to gradually restore your zombie king and generals to their former power, and you can customize the evolution of your zombie army in any direction you like.
9. Updated voice acting resources, and some other convenience optimization
Note: Since the game has been drastically updated, you need to reopen an archive. Sorry for any inconvenience caused to you.

The Heart of Thundering Python DLC update
Heart of Thundering Python is an ultimate artifact that once belonged to the Kingdom of Mist. This lost artifact is the key to unlocking mighty lightning powers for your zombie generals. 
To celebrate the full release, the Thunder Python Heart DLC will be given free with the game proper to players who purchase the game during the EA phase!
Price: $1.99 USD
Note: If you purchased the game during EA but did not unlock the DLC, please join our Discord server to contact the administrator with proof of purchase. We will send you a CDK as long as you provide us with proof.

Steam trading card and Achievement update
We will also be releasing Steam Trading Cards and more than 20 achievements in the near future. Please refer to the actual version for the specific card style and achievement content.

Finally, thank you for your support and have fun!

Swarm the City Team

notes.title: Zombiemania Party
notes.content:
Hey Zombies, 

We are on the edge of fighting. To keep each of you in good shape, the zombie community committee, including generals and Karr's secretaries, has come up with these activities. Participate, so we can stay ready for any situation against human beings.

Join us now and see more details about rules: https://discord.gg/fQKHNHDcXP

Event 1: Zombie Quiz
Each quiz day between 8 am and 9 am PDT, I will post a set of quiz questions on our server. Treat this as a training camp, and you will be good while facing humans.
Time
October 21, 23, 25, 27, 29. A total of five days.
Rules
- Play the game to find out the answers to the quiz questions;
- Post your answers as a reply to each day's quiz post;
Rewards
- 10 UZD steam giftcard for each winner.

Event 2: Zombie's Voice Matters
Let our zombie brethren, our followers, and humans all hear our voices. We can't stay silent while fighting.
Time
October 21 - November 1
Rules
- Write down your words (your comments and reviews) on Steam, and let the world know who we are and how the battle goes.
- Screenshot your words and post in #our-voice-matter channel.
- By October 31 when this ends, we will randomly select 50 zombies (yes, 50) to each win 10 UZD steam giftcard.

Event 3: Zombtubers Wanted
Youtubers are taking too many market shares. Zombtubers need to work harder. Creativity matters and zombies cannot lose to humans on that.
Time
October 21 - November 1
Rules
- Make videos on anything related to this Zombie Human war. It could be something funny, story remaking, or playthroughs. 
- Post your work to #zombtubers channel.
- After November 1, we will select the best nine videos whose zombtubers will get steam giftcard rewards
Rewards
- 1st place: 1 zombtuber, 100 UZD steam giftcard
- 2nd place: 3 zombtubers, 50 UZD steam giftcard
- 3rd place: 5 zombtubers, 25 UZD steam giftcard

Event 4: Frontline Battle Reporters
Broadcast the imagine of the war to the whole world. Show them how we deal with humans. You have the support from us, your zombie brethren. And let us reach to more brothers and sisters out there.
Time
October 21 - November 1
Rules
- Stream the game, and post your link to #battle-reporters channel.
- You have to stream for at least 1 hour.
- All participants will receive 10 UZD steam giftcard.
 Note
- Karr will be there with us watching your stream. Keep a record of your stream videos. You can't lie to the King.

Event 5: Problem Identifier
Our power system sometimes goes wrong or dysfunctional, and our zombie mechanical engineers are constantly fixing them. But we need all the zombies to help us identify those problems.
Time
Oct 15 - Oct 21
Rules
- Point out the problems and post in feedback channels;
- We will randomly select 20 zombies as the winners;
- Among the 20 winners, we will randomly select 3 lucky zombies to get more rewards;
Rewards
- 20 primary winners: 10 UZD steam giftcard
- 3 lucky zombies: 25 UZD steam giftcard
- Three of all the participants will be randomly selected to each get a free copy of the full game.

Event 6: Halloween Horror Stories
I don't know if you know about this, but Halloween is a zombie festival! It's funny seeing how humans celebrate it while dressing like us. For this year's Halloween, you will feel the most correct atmosphere here. Check it out.
Time
October 28 - November 1
Rules
- Create short horror stories, either long or short, and post in the #halloween channel.
- We will select the best 16 stories as winners.
Rewards
- First place: 1 zombie, 50 UZD steam giftcard
- Second place: 5 zombies, 25 UZD steam giftcard
- Third place: 10 zombies, 10 UZD steam giftcard

notes.title: Zombie Recruitment
notes.content:
Hey Zombies,

A storm is coming next week. Humans outnumber us. We can't face them yet. 
Thus, you have received the call from the King of Death.
No matter how you got here, welcome to the zombie realm! 

Join the party now
Come to our base on Discord: https://discord.gg/fQKHNHDcXP
A screenshot of Swarm the City: Zombie Evolved on your wishlist will be your ticket to the party. Just post yours in the wishlist-event channel after you get in.

Rules from the King of Death
Event 1 - Zombie Recruitment
Find anyone you loved, you hated, you cuddled, you kissed, you slept with... turn them into zombies and invite them here.
Time
Oct 15 - Oct 21
Rules
- Invite your fellow zombies to this zombie place.
- Tell the new zombies you invite here to send a message in zombie-recruitment channel, and @you. This will be the sign-up.
- The message should be "Hooah!" 
- We will randomly select 5 players as the winners. If any of them was invited by you, you will be a winner too.
Rewards
- 10 UZD steam giftcard for each winner.

Event 2 -  Zombie Fellowship
Humans are big big bullies. That's why we gathered here.
As a zombie rookie, what do you want to do? What's your destiny?
Share your stories with us.
Time
Oct 15 - Oct 21
Rules
- Post your zombie stories in #fellowship channel.
- After the event is over, we will select 10 zombies with the best stories as the winners.
Rewards
- 10 UZD steam giftcard

Wait, what is UZD?
UZD is our zombie money currency, and 1 UZD = 1 USD.
You know how humans are greedy. They even betray their own people for money. 
Seeing the profitability of zombies, humans have accepted our zombie currency so that they could make deals with us.

notes.title: Swarm the City Devs Livestream

Welcome!

This is Seasun Game's devs team. We are happy that we have this chance to present you our new game, Swarm the City.

Next Saturday, we will meet you at the devs livestream, where we will cover at least the following topics:
- A brief intro of our team

- Our future plans
- Q&A

What we will actually talk about might be more than these depending on how much time we have. The goal is to make sure you get enough information about us and this game.

We'll see you on June 20th. :)

notes.title: Swarm the City Alpha Test Has Started
notes.content:
The alpha test of our new game, Swarm the City has started. 

If you are in our discord server already, make sure you get a game key there to play the game. If you haven't, please hop in, https://discord.gg/fQKHNHDcXP

There are three events going on with the test. If you participate, you may have a chance to win steam giftcards ($5, $10, and $25). All the events are happening on discord. So make sure you are in there if you want to participate.
